title: Post-submit confirmation screen (register reference, KPI recap, sync status)

mockup_description.layout: Full-page success screen shown after tapping 'Enregistrer la présence'.
key_elements: Big checkmark animation, 'Présence enregistrée', 'Le registre a été soumis avec succès. Les compteurs ont été mis à jour.'
Metadata card: 'Référence du registre' (REG-2025-05-20-3A-01), Classe, Matière, Horaire, 'Soumis le'
KPI recap tiles: Présents / Retards / Absents / Excusés counts for this submission
'Les notifications SMS sont enregistrées en mode simulation' banner with a 'Mode simulation' badge -- explains no real SMS was sent
Bottom status line: 'Synchronisation serveur réussie -- Données enregistrées et sécurisées' with timestamp
interactions: Terminal state after a successful submit, not just an inline toast -- gives the teacher a durable reference number to cite if a parent disputes a mark

what_matches: A success message IS shown on save (json.message from POST /api/attendance), and the SMS-simulation convention is real and consistent with this mockup's 'Mode simulation' framing
Real KPI-like counts could be derived client-side from the just-saved records
what_differs: Current success feedback is a small inline banner within the same page, not a dedicated confirmation screen

No 'register reference number' concept exists at all -- there is no register entity anymore (see 05-mobile-register-lifecycle.json for why), so there's nothing to generate a REG-2025-05-20-3A-01-style ID from
No explicit 'Synchronisation serveur réussie' sync-status indicator (not meaningful currently since there's no offline-first/local-draft layer to sync FROM)

missing_to_add.item: Dedicated post-submit confirmation view/step (could be a modal or a route transition) showing the KPI recap + SMS-simulation notice
missing_to_add.notes: Cosmetic upgrade over the current inline banner -- not blocked on anything.

Directly depends on the register-lifecycle decision in 05-mobile-register-lifecycle.json -- a reference number is far more natural once there's a register row to attach it to than as a standalone concept bolted onto the current per-record attendance table.
